Description: Mada is Beler's spouse and the mother of Storane, Respendial and Attaces. Her place in this Alan household binds her to relatives with different prospects and obligations. She values reliable kinship, but does not mistake family unity for the right of one person to decide every other's fate. When an alliance is proposed, she asks what it will demand of each child and who will protect those left behind. A prestigious promise is worth little if fulfilling it leaves dependants without food or protection. She can urge restraint without surrendering the dignity of her house, and give practical help without treating generosity as a contest in public display. Her composed manner conceals a firm refusal to let distant glory outweigh immediate responsibility. Loyalty to Beler does not erase her judgement: a venture that exposes the household requires an answer more substantial than appeals to honour. She wants her children to retain ties to one another even when their interests diverge.
